title: Act artifact-producing BDD contract
summary: Phase 27 BDD/e2e coverage must run real act jobs as isolated artifact producers and assert durable artifacts produced through the bind-mounted workspace. Mock tools and exit-code-only assertions are insufficient.
requirements: Phase 27 BDD scenarios for development workflow targets must invoke real act jobs rather than fake tools.
Act jobs must produce durable, host-visible artifacts in stable workspace paths.
BDD assertions must inspect produced artifacts and their content or parseability; successful exit code alone is not sufficient.
Workflow jobs may pass output from one act invocation to another through stable workspace artifacts or workflow job dependencies.
The artifact acquisition strategy must be agreed before implementation.
conflicts: Current Phase 27 validation notes still describe fake external dependencies for Messages/Docs BDD scenarios.
Current Act BDD coverage records dry-run success as sufficient for workflow target validation.
